performance.verdict: $507 spent across 28 days; zero leads — conversion tracking is broken, not ads.

findings.text: Zero leads recorded across all 28 days despite $507.31 Google spend and 116 clicks — confirmed tracking failure, not audience failure.
5 overdue SOW milestones (earliest Jul 20): Paid Landing Pages, UGC Batch, End-to-End Stack Re-Test, GHL Build gaps, and Stripe QA — all unverified as complete.
GBP actions collapsed -81.25% week-over-week (from ~16 to ~3 actions last 7 days); last 3 days show 0 GBP actions vs 9 avg prior 3 days — organic visibility dropped sharply.
GA4 sessions averaged 24 over last 3 days vs 30 prior 3 days — a mild 20% dip, but 674 sessions with 0 GA4 conversions confirms the conversion event is not firing.
GHL shows 120 opportunities created with $0 value and 0 won; no pipeline revenue against 165 contacts — intake path is alive but no monetary value is being mapped.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair Google Ads conversion tracking immediately; 116 clicks and $507.31 spent with zero conversions recorded.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $507.31 over 28 days across 116 clicks with zero conversions recorded anywhere — GA4, GHL, or Google Ads. The conversion tag or destination URL is broken. Verify the thank-you page fires the Google tag and that GA4 conversion events are mapped; run a test submission end-to-end. Success is confirmed when at least one test conversion appears in Google Ads and GA4 within 48 hours — by 2026-09-07.

suggestions.text: Pause scaling BWS - Belle Watch - Sales ($282.87 of $507.31 spend) until conversion tracking is confirmed working.
suggestions.monday_update: BWS - Belle Watch - Sales consumed $282.87 of the 28-day budget with zero verified leads. Do not increase its budget until S1 tracking fix is confirmed and at least one real lead is recorded. Re-check on 2026-09-10 — if tracking is repaired and leads appear, scaling can be evaluated at that point.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing health; actions fell -81.25% week-over-week with 0 actions last 3 days — check for suspension or listing edits.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped -81.25% week-over-week and have been zero for the last 3 days (Sep 2–4). Log into the Google Business Profile dashboard and check for any suspension notices, unverified edits, or policy flags. Confirm the listing status is fully published and that the phone number and service area are correct. Success is GBP actions returning above 3 per day by 2026-09-10.
